context: A uni student interviews a retired craftsman at home
purpose: Teach: 救急車/アトピー/大工/言説/無力/暗闇/筆頭/狂気

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本日はお時間をいただきありがとうございます。早速ですが、ヒロシさんは長年大工をされていたんですよね？
lines.en: Thank you for your time today. So, Hiroshi-san, you worked as a carpenter for many years, right?
lines.style: Polite university student, formal interview opening, slightly nervous

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ああ、五十年以上な。若い頃は職人の筆頭として、大きな現場をいくつも任されたもんだ。
lines.en: Ah, over fifty years. When I was young, as the lead craftsman, I was put in charge of many big sites.
lines.style: Gruff elderly male, proud reminiscing tone, deliberate pace

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 筆頭職人ですか、すごいですね。お仕事で印象に残っている出来事はありますか？
lines.en: Lead craftsman, that's impressive. Are there any incidents from your work that stuck with you?
lines.style: Curious student follow-up, respectful and engaged

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: そうだな……一度、若い弟子が梁から落ちて、救急車を呼んだことがあった。あの時ばかりは自分の無力さを痛感したよ。
lines.en: Well... once a young apprentice fell off a beam and we had to call an ambulance. That time I really felt my own powerlessness.
lines.style: Somber elder recalling deep regret, voice softening noticeably with age

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: それは辛い経験でしたね……。ちなみに、職人の世界には根性論みたいな言説も多いと聞きますが、実際はどうでしたか？
lines.en: That must have been hard... By the way, I've heard there's a lot of discourse about willpower in the craftsman world. How was it really?
lines.style: Sympathetic transition with gentle academic curiosity returning slowly

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ふん、根性で全部解決するなんて狂気の沙汰だよ。徹夜続きで暗闇の中で釘を打つようなことを美徳にしちゃいかん。
lines.en: Hmph, thinking willpower solves everything is sheer madness. We shouldn't romanticize hammering nails in the dark after all-nighters.
lines.style: Blunt grandfatherly criticism, dismissive snort, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど、現場のリアルな声ですね。最後に、健康面で気をつけていることはありますか？
lines.en: I see, that's the real voice from the field. Lastly, is there anything you watch out for health-wise?
lines.style: Wrapping up interview, gentle pivot to softer topic

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 木の粉でアトピーが悪化する弟子もいたから、防塵は大事だな。若い君も体は大切にしなさいよ。
lines.en: Some apprentices had their atopic dermatitis flare up from wood dust, so dust protection is important. You young folks should take care of your bodies too.
lines.style: Warm closing advice, paternal warmth surfacing
